_meta.description: Complete system manifest for the Supplier Data Collection platform. Covers topology, home base tables, per-client tables, recipe contracts, webhook payloads, Workflow App bindings, and correlation threading. Intended as a development reference.

conventions.id_generation: All business IDs are UUIDs generated by the recipe that creates the row. Never pre-generated by upstream systems.
conventions.correlation_id: Originates in the webhook payload from Apps Script. Threaded through every recipe handoff and stamped on every entity that traces back to the originating request.
conventions.version_freezing: Version is frozen at two points: (1) R-2a stamps manifest_id on Requests, (2) R-008 stamps assigned_version_id on each WFA_SupplierRequest. Downstream recipes always read version from the frozen pointer, never from a 'current' flag.
conventions.relation_columns: Workato relation-type columns are UI display helpers only. All real joins use business ID string fields.
conventions.status_transitions: All status fields are forward-only. No rollbacks.

workspace.description: A single Workato workspace containing the base project and all client folders (Case A). Case B (multi-workspace) is deferred to a future phase.

base_project.description: The control plane. Owns the webhook endpoint, home base Data Tables, provisioning logic, and the template definitions. Contains no client data.

client_folder_template.description: A top-level folder created by R-2a for each client. Self-contained: tables, recipes, and Workflow App. Everything a team member needs for a client is inside this folder.

contains.workflow_app: Supplier-facing portal scoped to this client's data

home_base_tables.name: WorkspaceRegistry
home_base_tables.purpose: Tracks workspace capacity and assignment. For Case A (single workspace), this table has one row representing the current workspace. Becomes meaningful in Case B when multiple workspaces exist.

schema.name: workspace_id
schema.hint: Business PK. Workato workspace identifier.

schema.name: workspace_name
schema.hint: Human-readable name.

schema.name: status
schema.hint: Values: AVAILABLE | ASSIGNED | FULL. AVAILABLE = can accept new projects.

schema.name: project_count
schema.hint: Current number of active client folders. Used for capacity checks.

schema.name: max_capacity
schema.hint: Maximum client folders before workspace is marked FULL. Null = unlimited.

schema.name: api_endpoint
schema.hint: Base URL for this workspace's API. Relevant for Case B cross-workspace calls.

schema.name: registered_at
schema.hint: When this workspace was added to the registry.

home_base_tables.name: Requests
home_base_tables.purpose: One row per webhook received. The lifecycle record for a data collection request, from intake through provisioning to active operation. correlation_id is the primary tracing key.

schema.name: request_id
schema.hint: Business PK (UUID). Generated by R-1.

schema.name: correlation_id
schema.hint: From webhook payload. Unique. The cross-system tracing key.

schema.name: client_name
schema.hint: From webhook payload.

schema.name: analyst_email
schema.hint: From webhook payload.

schema.name: target_vms
schema.hint: From webhook payload.

schema.name: drive_file_id
schema.hint: From webhook payload. Google Drive file containing seed data.

schema.name: workspace_id
schema.hint: FK → WorkspaceRegistry.workspace_id. Set by R-1b after routing.

schema.name: project_folder_id
schema.hint: Workato folder ID created by R-2a. Set after provisioning.

schema.name: manifest_id
schema.hint: FK → Manifests.manifest_id. Frozen at provision time by R-2a. Immutable once set.

schema.name: status
schema.hint: Values: PENDING | PROVISIONING | ACTIVE | REJECTED | FAILED. Forward transitions only.

schema.name: error_reason
schema.hint: Populated when status = REJECTED or FAILED.

schema.name: received_at
schema.hint: Webhook receipt timestamp. Immutable.

schema.name: provisioned_at
schema.hint: Set by R-2a on successful provisioning.

home_base_tables.name: Manifests
home_base_tables.purpose: Version registry for the per-client table schema and template definition. One row per published manifest version. Only one row has is_current = true at any time.

schema.name: manifest_id
schema.hint: Business PK (UUID). Generated by R-00.

schema.name: manifest_hash
schema.hint: SHA-256 of the canonical manifest JSON. Used for idempotency — if hash matches current, R-00 skips the write.

schema.name: schema_version
schema.hint: Semantic version from _meta.schema_version in the data table manifest (e.g., '2.2.0').

schema.name: snapshot_file_id
schema.hint: FileStorage ID of the full manifest JSON snapshot. The authoritative artifact.

schema.name: is_current
schema.hint: Only one row is true. R-00 flips previous to false before writing new.

schema.name: created_at
schema.hint: When this manifest version was published by R-00.

per_client_tables.note: Full schemas are in data_table_manifest_v4.json. Not duplicated here to avoid drift. R-2a reads v4 at runtime.

webhook_contract.source: Google Apps Script (menu action in Google Sheets)
webhook_contract.target: R-1 webhook endpoint in base project

drive_file_id.source: Sheet cell. Google Drive file ID for seed data.

webhook_contract.notes: This is the entire Apps Script footprint. No provisioning, no registry, no API client. Read fields, stamp correlation_id + timestamp, POST once.

base_project.name: Package & Version

trigger.notes: Scheduled or manual. Runs when template definition changes.

base_project.purpose: Snapshots the current template project definition into a versioned manifest. The only recipe that writes to the Manifests table.
reads: Template definition (FileStorage or Data Table in base project)

outputs.manifest_id: UUID of the new manifest row

steps: 1. Read the current template definition (data_table_manifest_v4.json or equivalent from FileStorage).
2. Compute SHA-256 hash of the canonical JSON.
3. Query Manifests for is_current = true. Compare manifest_hash.
4. If hash matches → no change, exit. (Idempotency guard.)
5. If hash differs → flip existing is_current row to false.
6. Write new Manifests row: manifest_id (UUID), manifest_hash, schema_version, snapshot_file_id, is_current = true, created_at = now.
7. Optionally: store the JSON snapshot in FileStorage and record the file ID.
base_project.correlation_id: Not applicable. R-00 is not request-scoped.

base_project.name: Receive Webhook
base_project.purpose: Front door. Validates inbound payload, logs a Requests row, and hands off to routing. Guarantees one Requests row per webhook regardless of downstream outcome.
inputs: Webhook payload (correlation_id, client_name, analyst_email, target_vms, drive_file_id, timestamp)

outputs.request_id: UUID of the new Requests row

steps: 1. Parse webhook payload.
2. Validate required fields: correlation_id (UUID format), client_name (non-empty), analyst_email (email format), timestamp (ISO-8601).
3. If validation fails → write Requests row with status = REJECTED, error_reason = '<details>'. Stop.
4. Write Requests row: request_id (UUID), correlation_id, client_name, analyst_email, target_vms, drive_file_id, status = PENDING, received_at = now.
5. Call R-1b with: request_id, correlation_id, client_name, analyst_email, target_vms, drive_file_id.
base_project.correlation_id: Received in payload → stamped on Requests row → passed to R-1b.

base_project.name: Route Request
base_project.purpose: Routing decision. For Case A (Phase 1), this is a near-passthrough — checks workspace availability and calls R-2a. Becomes meaningful for Case B.
steps: 1. Query WorkspaceRegistry for status = AVAILABLE (or ASSIGNED with project_count < max_capacity).
2. If no workspace available → update Requests status = FAILED, error_reason = 'No workspace capacity'. Stop. (For Case A Phase 1, this should never happen.)
3. Update Requests row: workspace_id = selected workspace.
4. Update WorkspaceRegistry: increment project_count.
5. Call R-2a with: request_id, correlation_id, workspace_id, client_name, analyst_email, target_vms, drive_file_id.
base_project.correlation_id: Received from R-1 → passed to R-2a.

base_project.name: Provision Client Folder
base_project.purpose: The manifest consumer. Creates the client folder, instantiates all 12 Data Tables from the manifest, applies deferred relations, clones template recipes, rebinds table references, sets up the Workflow App, and records the result.
steps: 1. Read Manifests row where is_current = true. Extract manifest_id and snapshot_file_id.
2. Load manifest JSON from FileStorage (or inline). Parse tables[] and deferred_relations[].
3. Update Requests status = PROVISIONING.
--- FOLDER CREATION ---
4. Create top-level folder: SDC_{client_name}_{correlation_id_short}.
--- PASS 1: TABLE CREATION ---
5. For each table in manifest.tables[] (in order):
a. POST /data_tables with name, schema columns, folder_id.
b. Capture response: table_id, field UUIDs.
c. Store in results_map: { table_name → { table_id, fields: { field_name → field_uuid } } }.
--- PASS 2: DEFERRED RELATIONS ---
6. For each update in manifest.deferred_relations[].updates[]:
a. Resolve _resolved_table_id from results_map[relation.table_name].table_id.
b. Resolve _resolved_field_id from results_map[relation.table_name].fields[relation.display_field_name].
c. PUT relation column onto results_map[target_table].table_id.
--- RECIPE CLONING ---
7. For each template recipe (R-008, R-004, R-007a, R-002, R-006):
a. Copy recipe into the client folder.
b. Walk the cloned recipe's Data Table references.
c. Rebind each reference from template table IDs → client table IDs using results_map.
--- SEED DATA ---
8. Insert default rows (CFG_ErrorTranslation defaults, etc.) using field UUIDs from results_map.
--- ROOT ENTITY ---
9. Insert WFA_TemplateProject row: template_project_id (UUID), project_name = client_name, analyst_email, target_vms, correlation_id.
--- WORKFLOW APP ---
10. Configure Workflow App portal for this folder. Bind to WFA_SupplierRequest and RUN_Upload tables.
--- BOOKKEEPING ---
11. Update Requests: project_folder_id, manifest_id, status = ACTIVE, provisioned_at = now.
base_project.correlation_id: Received from R-1b → stamped on WFA_TemplateProject → available to all per-client recipes.
base_project.error_handling: If any step fails, update Requests status = FAILED with error_reason. Consider cleanup of partially created resources.

client_folder.name: Bootstrap Supplier Requests

trigger.notes: Called by analyst action (Workflow App or manual) after template version is published.

client_folder.purpose: Creates WFA_SupplierRequest rows for each supplier. Freezes the template version and optionally assigns a variant per supplier.
steps: 1. Read WFA_TemplateProject to get correlation_id and project context.
2. Read VER_TemplateVersion. Confirm status = published. Get template_version_id.
3. For each supplier in the input list:
a. Generate supplier_request_id (UUID).

b. Insert WFA_SupplierRequest: supplier_request_id, template_project_id, assigned_version_id = template_version_id (FROZEN), assigned_variant_id (if provided), correlation_id, supplier_name, contact_email, assignee_email = analyst_email, has_seeded_data, status = pending.
4. Optionally: if drive_file_id was provided, prepare seeded data files per supplier.
client_folder.version_behavior: assigned_version_id is IMMUTABLE after write. This is the first freeze point.
client_folder.correlation_id: Read from WFA_TemplateProject → stamped on each WFA_SupplierRequest.

client_folder.name: Outreach

trigger.notes: Triggered per supplier request or in batch after R-008.

client_folder.purpose: Generates the supplier-facing template (filtered by variant if applicable), sends the outreach email/portal link, and updates status.
inputs: supplier_request_id or batch filter (template_project_id + status = pending)
steps: 1. Read WFA_SupplierRequest(s) where status = pending.
2. For each request:
a. Read assigned_version_id → use it to query CFG_Field (WHERE template_version_id = assigned_version_id).
b. If assigned_variant_id is NOT null:
- Join CFG_VariantField (WHERE variant_id = assigned_variant_id) → CFG_Field to get only VISIBLE fields.
c. If assigned_variant_id IS null:
- Use full CFG_Field set (all fields visible, no variant filtering).
d. Generate the supplier template file (Excel/CSV with visible columns in position order).
e. If has_seeded_data = true, populate template with pre-filled rows.
f. Store template in FileStorage → write seeded_template_file_id.
g. Send outreach email with portal link and/or template attachment.
h. Update status = sent, last_updated_at = now.
client_folder.version_behavior: Always reads CFG data via the frozen assigned_version_id. Never queries for 'current' version.

client_folder.name: Upload Intake

trigger.notes: Triggered when a supplier submits a file through the Workflow App portal.

client_folder.purpose: Logs the upload, freezes the version reference (copied from supplier request), and kicks off validation.
steps: 1. Identify the WFA_SupplierRequest from the Workflow App submission context.
2. Store the submitted file in FileStorage → get submitted_file_id.

3. Insert RUN_Upload: upload_id (UUID), supplier_request_id, template_version_id = WFA_SupplierRequest.assigned_version_id (FROZEN — copied, not looked up), submitted_file_id, status = received, submitted_at = now.
4. Update WFA_SupplierRequest: file_upload = submitted_file_id, status = in_progress, last_updated_at = now.
5. Call R-002 with: upload_id, supplier_request_id.
client_folder.version_behavior: template_version_id on RUN_Upload is COPIED from WFA_SupplierRequest.assigned_version_id. Second freeze point — the upload inherits the supplier's frozen version.

client_folder.name: Validation
client_folder.purpose: The core validation engine. Reads the frozen configuration (fields, rules, lookups) and validates the uploaded file against them. Writes results and field-level errors.
reads: CFG_VariantField (if variant applies — filters visible fields)
steps: 1. Read RUN_Upload to get template_version_id and submitted_file_id.
2. Update RUN_Upload status = extracting.
3. Extract/parse the uploaded file. Store normalized version → extracted_file_version_id.
4. Update RUN_Upload status = validating.
5. Load configuration (all scoped by template_version_id from the upload):
a. CFG_Field — full field definitions.
b. If WFA_SupplierRequest.assigned_variant_id is set → join CFG_VariantField to filter to visible fields only.
c. CFG_Rule — cross-field rules.
d. CFG_Lookup — valid value lists (joined via CFG_Field.lookup_name).
e. CFG_ErrorTranslation — error code → message mappings.
6. Insert RUN_ValidationResult: validation_result_id (UUID), upload_id, template_version_id, status = running.
7. For each row in the uploaded data:
a. Single-field validations: required, data_type, data_format, field_length, numeric range, date range, regex (field_input_validation), lookup membership, column uniqueness, must_be_empty.
b. Cross-field validations: evaluate CFG_Rule entries (rule verb + condition_field_id + conditional_value).

c. For each failure: insert RUN_FieldError with field_id, row_number, submitted_value, error_message (from CFG_Rule.error_message or CFG_Rule.error_message_custom if present, or CFG_ErrorTranslation lookup).
d. Track strict_enforcement — if strict = true on CFG_Field or strict_enforcement = true on CFG_Rule, the failure rejects the row.
8. After all rows processed:
a. Update RUN_ValidationResult: status = passed|failed, valid_rows, invalid_rows, completed_at.
b. If any valid rows → store in RUN_Upload.valid_payload (JSON).
c. Update RUN_Upload status = validated|failed.
9. Optionally call R-006 to generate the results report.
client_folder.version_behavior: ALL configuration reads are scoped by template_version_id from RUN_Upload. This is the version that was frozen at upload intake (R-007a), which was itself copied from the supplier request (R-008). Three-step chain of custody: R-008 freezes → R-007a copies → R-002 reads.

client_folder.name: Results & Reporting

trigger.notes: Can also be triggered manually for re-generation.

client_folder.purpose: Generates supplier-facing validation report. Translates field-level errors into human-readable output. Updates supplier request status.
steps: 1. Read RUN_ValidationResult for the given upload_id.
2. Read RUN_FieldError rows for the validation_result_id.
3. Join RUN_FieldError.field_id → CFG_Field.field_id to resolve field_name for human-readable output.
4. Optionally join error codes → CFG_ErrorTranslation for supplier-friendly messaging.
5. Generate output report (Excel/PDF) with: field name, row number, submitted value, error message.
6. Store report in FileStorage.
7. Update WFA_SupplierRequest status:
a. If RUN_ValidationResult.status = passed → status = validated.
b. If RUN_ValidationResult.status = failed → status = rejected.
8. Send notification to supplier (email and/or Workflow App) with report link.
9. Update WFA_SupplierRequest.last_updated_at.

workflow_app.purpose: Supplier-facing portal. Allows suppliers to view their request, upload files, and see validation results without direct access to Workato tables or recipes.

bound_tables.notes: Supplier uploads files here. R-007a triggers on new submissions.

workflow_app.triggers_recipe: R-007a (on file submission via the portal)
workflow_app.scoping: Each Workflow App instance is scoped to a single client folder. Suppliers only see their own requests (filtered by contact_email on WFA_SupplierRequest).

correlation_threading.description: The correlation_id originates in Apps Script and flows through every layer of the system. This section documents where it is generated, passed, stored, and readable.

flow.medium: Parsed from payload → written to Requests row → passed to R-1b
Received from R-1 → passed to R-2a
Received from R-1b → stamped on WFA_TemplateProject
Read from WFA_TemplateProject → stamped on each WFA_SupplierRequest
Available via WFA_SupplierRequest join. Not passed as explicit input — readable from the data.

use_cases: Trace a failed recipe job back to the originating webhook
Link a supplier validation error to the original analyst request
Cross-reference home base Requests status with per-client project state
Debug by searching all three tables for a single correlation_id

version_chain_of_custody.description: Documents how a template version is frozen and propagated through the system, ensuring no version drift reaches the validation layer.

chain.description: R-2a reads Manifests.is_current = true, stamps manifest_id on the Requests row. This ties the entire client project to a specific manifest version. Immutable after write.
R-008 reads the published VER_TemplateVersion and stamps its template_version_id on each supplier request. This ties each supplier to a specific template version. Immutable after write.
R-007a COPIES template_version_id from WFA_SupplierRequest.assigned_version_id onto the upload. Inherited, not looked up. Immutable.
R-002 COPIES template_version_id from RUN_Upload onto the validation result. Direct traceability. Immutable.

version_chain_of_custody.invariant: At no point does any recipe query for a 'current' version after R-008. Every downstream entity inherits its version from its parent via an immutable copy.
